comparison.objective: Seat gold avionics modules on four standoffs and place blue covers flat on top.
comparison.physical_skill: Four-point alignment, planar seating, and layered assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Each module and cover centered within 5 mm, correctly oriented, seated, and flat.
comparison.reason: Multi-point seating is an assembly-alignment task without impact-driven separation or loose-fragment containment.
